extra.final_summary: The data had two main issues: (1) two rows with negative flipper lengths (row 16 and 42) were excluded as they are physically impossible; (2) the 'island' column had inconsistent spacing (e.g., ' Dream', 'Biscoe ') and was normalized. The 'sex' column had case variants ('FEMALE', 'MALE') which were normalized to lowercase. After these fixes, the analysis was run on 20 Adelie penguins. The average bill length by island is: Biscoe: 37.74 mm, Dream: 36.7 mm, Torgersen: 40.1 mm.
